name: route53
description: Amazon Route 53 is a highly available and scalable Domain Name System (DNS) web service.

subcommands.name: activate-key-signing-key
subcommands.description: Activates a key-signing key (KSK) so that it can be used for signing by DNSSEC.

subcommands.name: associate-vpc-with-hosted-zone
subcommands.description: Associates an Amazon VPC with a private hosted zone.

subcommands.name: change-cidr-collection
subcommands.description: Creates, changes, or deletes CIDR blocks within a collection.

subcommands.name: change-resource-record-sets
subcommands.description: Creates, changes, or deletes a resource record set, which contains authoritative DNS information for a specified domain name or subdomain name.

subcommands.name: change-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Adds, edits, or deletes tags for a health check or a hosted zone.

subcommands.name: create-cidr-collection
subcommands.description: Creates a CIDR collection in the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-health-check
subcommands.description: Creates a new health check.

subcommands.name: create-hosted-zone
subcommands.description: Creates a new public or private hosted zone.

subcommands.name: create-key-signing-key
subcommands.description: Creates a new key-signing key (KSK) associated with a hosted zone.

subcommands.name: create-query-logging-config
subcommands.description: Creates a configuration for DNS query logging.

subcommands.name: create-reusable-delegation-set
subcommands.description: Creates a delegation set (a group of four name servers) that can be reused by multiple hosted zones that were created by the same Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-traffic-policy
subcommands.description: Creates a traffic policy, which you use to create multiple DNS resource record sets for one domain name (such as example.com) or one subdomain name (such as www.example.com).

subcommands.name: create-traffic-policy-instance
subcommands.description: Creates resource record sets in a specified hosted zone based on the settings in a specified traffic policy version.

subcommands.name: create-traffic-policy-version
subcommands.description: Creates a new version of an existing traffic policy.

subcommands.name: create-vpc-association-authorization
subcommands.description: Authorizes the Amazon Web Services account that created a specified VPC to submit an AssociateVPCWithHostedZone request to associate the VPC with a specified hosted zone that was created by a different account.

subcommands.name: deactivate-key-signing-key
subcommands.description: Deactivates a key-signing key (KSK) so that it will not be used for signing by DNSSEC.

subcommands.name: delete-cidr-collection
subcommands.description: Deletes a CIDR collection in the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: delete-health-check
subcommands.description: Deletes a health check.

subcommands.name: delete-hosted-zone
subcommands.description: Deletes a hosted zone.

subcommands.name: delete-key-signing-key
subcommands.description: Deletes a key-signing key (KSK).

subcommands.name: delete-query-logging-config
subcommands.description: Deletes a configuration for DNS query logging.

subcommands.name: delete-reusable-delegation-set
subcommands.description: Deletes a reusable delegation set.

subcommands.name: delete-traffic-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes a traffic policy.

subcommands.name: delete-traffic-policy-instance
subcommands.description: Deletes a traffic policy instance and all of the resource record sets that Amazon Route 53 created when you created the instance.

subcommands.name: delete-vpc-association-authorization
subcommands.description: Removes authorization to submit an AssociateVPCWithHostedZone request to associate a specified VPC with a hosted zone that was created by a different account.

subcommands.name: disable-hosted-zone-dnssec
subcommands.description: Disables DNSSEC signing in a specific hosted zone.

subcommands.name: disassociate-vpc-from-hosted-zone
subcommands.description: Disassociates an Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC) from an Amazon Route 53 private hosted zone.

subcommands.name: enable-hosted-zone-dnssec
subcommands.description: Enables DNSSEC signing in a specific hosted zone.

subcommands.name: get-account-limit
subcommands.description: Gets the specified limit for the current account, for example, the maximum number of health checks that you can create using the account.

subcommands.name: get-change
subcommands.description: Returns the current status of a change batch request.

subcommands.name: get-checker-ip-ranges
subcommands.description: Route 53 does not perform authorization for this API because it retrieves information that is already available to the public.

subcommands.name: get-dnssec
subcommands.description: Returns information about DNSSEC for a specific hosted zone, including the key-signing keys (KSKs) in the hosted zone.

subcommands.name: get-geo-location
subcommands.description: Gets information about whether a specified geographic location is supported for Amazon Route 53 geolocation resource record sets.

subcommands.name: get-health-check
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified health check.

subcommands.name: get-health-check-count
subcommands.description: Retrieves the number of health checks that are associated with the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-health-check-last-failure-reason
subcommands.description: Gets the reason that a specified health check failed most recently.

subcommands.name: get-health-check-status
subcommands.description: Gets status of a specified health check.

subcommands.name: get-hosted-zone
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified hosted zone including the four name servers assigned to the hosted zone.

subcommands.name: get-hosted-zone-count
subcommands.description: Retrieves the number of hosted zones that are associated with the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-hosted-zone-limit
subcommands.description: Gets the specified limit for a specified hosted zone, for example, the maximum number of records that you can create in the hosted zone.

subcommands.name: get-query-logging-config
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified configuration for DNS query logging.

subcommands.name: get-reusable-delegation-set
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a specified reusable delegation set, including the four name servers that are assigned to the delegation set.

subcommands.name: get-reusable-delegation-set-limit
subcommands.description: Gets the maximum number of hosted zones that you can associate with the specified reusable delegation set.

subcommands.name: get-traffic-policy
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specific traffic policy version.

subcommands.name: get-traffic-policy-instance
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified traffic policy instance.

subcommands.name: get-traffic-policy-instance-count
subcommands.description: Gets the number of traffic policy instances that are associated with the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-cidr-blocks
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of location objects and their CIDR blocks.

subcommands.name: list-cidr-collections
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of CIDR collections in the Amazon Web Services account (metadata only).

subcommands.name: list-cidr-locations
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of CIDR locations for the given collection (metadata only, does not include CIDR blocks).

subcommands.name: list-geo-locations
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of supported geographic locations.

subcommands.name: list-health-checks
subcommands.description: Retrieve a list of the health checks that are associated with the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-hosted-zones
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of the public and private hosted zones that are associated with the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-hosted-zones-by-name
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of your hosted zones in lexicographic order.

subcommands.name: list-hosted-zones-by-vpc
subcommands.description: Lists all the private hosted zones that a specified VPC is associated with, regardless of which Amazon Web Services account or Amazon Web Services service owns the hosted zones.

subcommands.name: list-query-logging-configs
subcommands.description: Lists the configurations for DNS query logging that are associated with the current Amazon Web Services account or the configuration that is associated with a specified hosted zone.

subcommands.name: list-resource-record-sets
subcommands.description: Lists the resource record sets in a specified hosted zone.

subcommands.name: list-reusable-delegation-sets
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of the reusable delegation sets that are associated with the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists tags for one health check or hosted zone.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resources
subcommands.description: Lists tags for up to 10 health checks or hosted zones.

subcommands.name: list-traffic-policies
subcommands.description: Gets information about the latest version for every traffic policy that is associated with the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-traffic-policy-instances
subcommands.description: Gets information about the traffic policy instances that you created by using the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-traffic-policy-instances-by-hosted-zone
subcommands.description: Gets information about the traffic policy instances that you created in a specified hosted zone.

subcommands.name: list-traffic-policy-instances-by-policy
subcommands.description: Gets information about the traffic policy instances that you created by using a specify traffic policy version.

subcommands.name: list-traffic-policy-versions
subcommands.description: Gets information about all of the versions for a specified traffic policy.

subcommands.name: list-vpc-association-authorizations
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the VPCs that were created by other accounts and that can be associated with a specified hosted zone because you've submitted one or more CreateVPCAssociationAuthorization requests.

subcommands.name: test-dns-answer
subcommands.description: Gets the value that Amazon Route 53 returns in response to a DNS request for a specified record name and type.

subcommands.name: update-health-check
subcommands.description: Updates an existing health check.

subcommands.name: update-hosted-zone-comment
subcommands.description: Updates the comment for a specified hosted zone.

subcommands.name: update-hosted-zone-features
subcommands.description: Updates the features configuration for a hosted zone.

subcommands.name: update-traffic-policy-comment
subcommands.description: Updates the comment for a specified traffic policy version.

subcommands.name: update-traffic-policy-instance
subcommands.description: After you submit a UpdateTrafficPolicyInstance request, there's a brief delay while Route 53 creates the resource record sets that are specified in the traffic policy definition.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: resource-record-sets-changed
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query ChangeInfo.Status returns INSYNC when polling with ``get-change``.
